items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: I said, well, I said, Steve Brown from New Orleans was president of Detroit Local, played rock in New Orleans, played tuba and string bass for years.

ctx.x: John Veeam rockin' his head. He was doing that years and years ago, see? There's that some bass player from Los Angeles. See, he invented picking string bass. So I wanted to know how old he was, see? He was a young man. So I said, well, I said, Steve Brown from New Orleans was president of Detroit Local, played rock in New Orleans, played tuba and string bass for years. He was picking, and I said, well before him, I said, Jimmy Johnson with the bowling band was picking bass way back in the 18-something and I had…
Oh, I heard of him, too.
